summary: Re-verified PPTX export after two follow-up fixes: (1) dead loop `for run in chart.legend.font.__dict__.get('_element', []) or []: pass` in _line_chart is gone; (2) footer page indicators now use total=15 (matching actual deck slide count). Extended /app/backend/tests/test_pptx_export.py with 5 new assertions: two source-code regression guards (dead loop absent, total=15) and one parametrised archive check across all three variants that parses every '<N> / <M>' pill from slide XML. All 38 tests pass in ~132s. Every generated deck (weekly/all, monthly/acme-corp, quarterly/globalbank) yields exactly one denominator = 15, no stale '/12' anywhere, and numerators are a strict subset of {3,4,6,8,10,11,13,14}.
critical_code_review_comments: pptx_export.py is still 1218 lines — remains beyond the 700-line guideline. Splitting into (primitives, widgets, native charts+table, per-slide builders) still recommended but non-blocking.

build_pptx() hard-codes both the page-number values (3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 11, 13, 14) and total=15. Would be more robust to compute total dynamically (e.g., from len(prs.slides) after build) or use a slide-index enum, so future re-orderings can't reintroduce the '/12' bug.
_donut_gauge still reaches into private chart._chartSpace via lxml qn(). Consider wrapping in try/except so a future python-pptx internals change fails gracefully instead of raising during export.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_pptx_export.py now includes: (a) TestSourceCode::test_source_dead_loop_removed guards against reintroducing the empty legend.font loop; (b) TestSourceCode::test_source_total_slide_count_is_15 pins total=15 and forbids the stale total=12; (c) TestPptxArchive::test_footer_page_indicators parses every 'N / M' pill from slide XML across all three variants and asserts: (i) at least one pill exists, (ii) no '/12' denominator, (iii) exactly one denominator equal to actual slide count (15), (iv) numerators subset of {3,4,6,8,10,11,13,14}, (v) every numerator <= denominator. Full suite runtime ~2m 12s (parallelised via pytest-xdist). Frontend not tested per request.
rca_of_the_issue: Two cosmetic issues flagged in iteration_2 have been resolved. (1) Dead loop removed — grep on pptx_export.py returns zero hits for `chart.legend.font.__dict__`. (2) Footer '13/12' & '14/12' bug — build_pptx() now declares `total = 15` (line 1186), matching the 15 actual slides (1 cover + 5 dividers + 8 content + 1 closing). Runtime evidence: for each of weekly/all, monthly/acme-corp, quarterly/globalbank, the extracted denominators set is exactly {15}, numerators are {3,4,6,8,10,11,13,14}, and no '/12' string is present anywhere in slide XML.
